text: Incoming qubit! Every enemy flies in from the right in state α|0⟩ + β|1⟩. The top number on each qubit is α, the bottom is β.
When a qubit reaches the left edge you lose P(0) × 100 HP, where P(0) = |α|². Turn every qubit into |1⟩ to stay safe.
Pick a gate from the top bar and click a grid line to place it. Right-click a gate to remove it. Press ▶ when you're ready.
Nicely flipped! A gate acts on every qubit that passes through it, so one well-placed gate can handle a whole lane.
Dummy level: two lanes, one CNOT. Binary gates sit on corners and act on the two qubits that cross them together.
Dummy level: phases matter once a Hadamard turns them into amplitudes.
